problem: Construct the vector field that has the stream function $ψ(x,y)=5{y}^{3}x-{x}^{3}-xy.$
worked_solution:
A function $ψ(x,y)$ is a stream function of the vector field $F=P\,i+Q\,j$ if the following equations hold:

$$
P=\frac{∂ψ}{∂y},\,Q=-\frac{∂ψ}{∂x}
$$

Computing the partial derivatives of the function $ψ(x,y),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P & =\frac{∂ψ}{∂y} \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(5{y}^{3}x-{x}^{3}-xy) \\  & =15x{y}^{2}-x, \\ Q & =-\frac{∂ψ}{∂x} \\  & =-\frac{∂}{∂x}(5{y}^{3}x-{x}^{3}-xy) \\  & =-(5{y}^{3}-3{x}^{2}-y).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the vector field with the stream function $ψ(x,y)=5{y}^{3}x-{x}^{3}-xy$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}F(x,y) & =P\,i+Q\,j \\  & =(15x{y}^{2}-x)\,i-(5{y}^{3}-3{x}^{2}-y)\,j.\end{aligned}
$$
